Inference Labs

Inference Labs provides GPU-optimized model serving infrastructure for teams deploying large language models in production. The platform handles auto-scaling, model versioning, A/B testing, and cost optimization across multi-cloud GPU clusters. Supports PyTorch, TensorFlow, and ONNX models. Processing over 2 billion inference requests daily for 150 enterprise customers. Usage-based pricing with average customer spend of $18,000/month. Raised $65M Series A. Founded in 2023 by former infrastructure leads from major AI labs. Team of 75 in San Francisco and Toronto.
